method: Sequential local-data prediction with per-pick relative scoring. For each team, every agent first computes raw local signals for the current available pool, converts those signals into relative scores within that team's remaining candidate pool, votes, locks a prospect only after at least 7/10 agreement, removes that prospect, then recomputes relative scores for the next team.
